title: Message summary
blurb: Summary shows one main point and up to six flat bullets in the reading pane or separate reader. English follows ASD-STE100-inspired plain language; formal compliance is not verified. Details holds message metadata and data-use information. Uses the saved AI connection when you request a summary. Missing setup offers Review AI settings. Only this message's downloaded text and quoted history are included; attachment files, linked pages, other messages, Brain and Agent history are excluded. A local coverage check sends no message text. Longer or incomplete text requires a choice: Summarize all downloaded text or a clearly labelled excerpt. Full runs are bounded by 128,000 source bytes, 31 AI requests, 16,000 input bytes per request and 512,000 input bytes per run. Each request asks for 1,200 output tokens and accepts 6,000 output bytes. These are app budgets, not measured model context limits. Full coverage is unavailable when the run cannot fit; no text is silently dropped. Unicode-safe parts are combined before displaying a completed result. Incomplete downloads and omitted excerpt text remain visible. Header/snippet-only messages need a body download first. Choose Summary again to retry, Cancel summary to stop waiting, or Dismiss summary to close it. A coverage review expires after five minutes and cannot survive message, saved connection or automatic processing changes. Source identity and the saved connection are checked before every AI request and before returning a result. One request times out after two minutes; a run with several requests after ten minutes. Cancellation cannot recall data already sent. Results stay in this window's memory. Summary creates no drafts or mail changes and adds no CLI command or bot permission.
